channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Wilson Chandler | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Wilson Chandler from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Jameer Nelson, Wilson Chandler
item.description:
Nikola Jokic:

“When I came to the NBA, I had Jameer Nelson and Wilson Chandler as role models when it came to training.”

Nikola Jokic on Jameer Nelson, Wilson Chandler, Sep 11, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Jameer Nelson, Mike Miller, Wilson Chandler, Darrell Arthur
item.description:
Nikola Jokic:

“Even then I had great veterans: Jameer Nelson, Mike Miller, Wilson Chandler, Darrell Arthur, who’s with us now. I know, I know ... Every day in the weight room. They were in the weight room every day. Every day they were in the gym. Jameer, he was dragging me around nonstop: a lunch, a dinner … I won’t name names now, but there were times in my organization where young players didn’t have the right role models and the right people to show them... to guide them. Mike Miller every time in a suit. It’s little things, but you see... that stuck with me: Mike Miller wore a suit every day.”

Nikola Jokic on Jameer Nelson, Mike Miller, Wilson Chandler, Darrell Arthur, Mar 9, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Lawrence Frank on Wilson Chandler, Landry Shamet
item.description:
“We are excited to welcome Wilson, Mike, and Landry to the L.A. Clippers. Wilson is a veteran player we have long respected for his toughness, versatility and leadership. His hard-nosed mentality will fit right in with the rest of this group,”

Lawrence Frank on Wilson Chandler, Landry Shamet, Feb 6, 2019. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Lawrence Frank on Wilson Chandler, Landry Shamet
item.description:
Frank continued,

“We have also admired Landry, a first round pick from Wichita State, since last year’s draft process. He has only justified expectations. Landry quickly earned a spot in the 76ers rotation and has been the most accurate three-point shooter in this year’s rookie class. In addition to Wilson, Mike, and Landry, we obtained multiple draft assets today that will be important building blocks as we continue to carry out our long-term plan -- to construct a sustainable championship contender.”

Lawrence Frank on Wilson Chandler, Landry Shamet, Feb 6, 2019. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Tim Connelly on Wilson Chandler
item.description:
Tim Connelly on Chandler:

“We want to thank Wilson for seven years in Denver. As good as a player as he is, he’s an even better person. He will be a great addition in Philly and we will certainly all be rooting for him.”

Tim Connelly on Wilson Chandler, Jul 6, 2018. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Michael Malone on Wilson Chandler
item.description:
“Obviously, Wilson can answer that himself when the time comes. But I've never heard anything close to that from Wilson.”

Michael Malone on Wilson Chandler, Feb 3, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Michael Malone on Wilson Chandler, Danilo Gallinari, Kenneth Faried, Darrell Arthur
item.description:
Michael Malone:

“We were a young team last year and we got a little bit younger through the draft which we’re excited about. It’s tough to win big in the NBA when you’re this young, but we feel we have a lot of good young players and assets. And you balance that with guys like (Danilo Gallinari) and (Kenneth) Faried, Darrell Arthur. People forget but we consider Wilson Chandler a free agent signing (since he missed all of last season).This is a long-term play. This is an opportunity to show improvement, for our players to get better and we have a chance to be here for a while.”

Michael Malone on Wilson Chandler, Danilo Gallinari, Kenneth Faried, Darrell Arthur, Aug 15, 2016. Source: BSN Denver.

item.title: Brian Shaw on Wilson Chandler
item.description:
“Obviously calls come in, and we field calls. But we're not saying, 'Hey, we're trying to get rid of Arron, we're trying to get rid of Wilson.' That's not the case at all. That's all we can really tell them.”

Brian Shaw on Wilson Chandler, Jan 14, 2015. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Chris Luchey on Wilson Chandler
item.description:
Chandler and Luchey are in Denver to continue discussing the matter with Nuggets GM Masai Ujiri.

“Wilson and I saw that [the Nuggets] had nine [home] games in a row and we decided to make this last push at a deal, come in town, negotiate for five days or less, and see if we can come to an agreement before he prepares for either sitting until July or going to Italy or [another] Europe locale,”

Chris Luchey on Wilson Chandler, Mar 12, 2012. Source: SI.com.

item.title: Jim Cleamons on Wilson Chandler
item.description:
Still, his teammates understand Chandler’s situation,

“I think they wish him well. If the shoe was on their foot and they had the opportunities that Wilson is going to have, they would wish him well,”

Jim Cleamons on Wilson Chandler, Feb 22, 2012. Source: NiuBBall.com.

item.title: Chris Luchey on Wilson Chandler
item.description:
“Wilson likes their direction and the stabilization of their roster in Denver with the young talent,”

Chris Luchey on Wilson Chandler, Feb 9, 2012. Source: Yahoo! Sports.
